reviews.title: Lori's Top 102
reviews.comment: The USB drive worked fine. However, when I opened the drive it contained a CD. Like a pearl held within an oyster. It appears to be a music mix CD of 'Lori's top 102 R/R Songs'. Not 99. Not 100. 102! Well I figured somebody's kid sister filled it with Taylor Swift Girl Power songs. Maybe rap perhaps. One doesn't know. So I dropped my daughter off at University and on the ride home I played the CD because my ancient 2013 Ford Fusion actually came with a DVD drive. MY GOD! It's primarily an 80's music CD with some 70'S stuff tossed in there. As a child of the 80's myself I almost cried. It started with Aerosmith 'Sweet Emotion' and 'Walk this Way'. Segued to 'Heat of the Moment' followed by 'White Wedding' by Billy Idol. Lori goes hard. I haven't had a chance to experience all 102 songs but there's also some Elvis Presley and The Doors 'People are Strange' which is on the nose for this era in America. It's not a perfect canon. In the middle of several Eagles songs she injected Cold Play, right out of the blue, which nearly provoked me to lose control of the automobile. Still, it's enough to say that Lori is a magnificent human being. This CD is more valuable than the enclosing USB drive which will only be used on rare occasions. I'll play this CD far more often So sure. Buy DVD drives from this guy
reviews.author: Stephen J. Agneta

reviews.title: Seems to be a good and very high quality unit, Faster RIP than expected!
reviews.comment: Seems to be a good unit so far. I purchased this to RIP DVD;s, have not tried as a Burner yet, and not sure that I will. This is a very high quality unit that seems to be sufficiently fast and is very compatible and easy to use. Has Standard storage of any CD or DVD, so the storage is the same. Unit functions well in Burning as well as Play Back. No Compatibility issues and I have not tried the playback issues yet!

reviews.title: Works reasonably well to download a DVD to my desktop. Works well with Windows 11.
reviews.comment: So far it works well to download files but seems slow and stops if you try to download a whole DVD. If you download a only a few folders at a time, it is very fast. I have not yet tried to burn any CDs or DVDs, but I'm hopeful. A longer cable to connect the drive to the desktop would be useful. Having cable storage is nice for transportation with my laptop .
